rule: Single source of truth for every image/clip prompt. Always keep the latest best version here; bump the item's version and add a line to prompts/CHANGELOG.md. Episode files are built from this by tools/build-shorts.mjs.

style.name: 2D noir graphic-novel cartoon, master style v4 (owner 2026-11-27: one style in every frame)
style.prefix: STYLE, identical in every shot: 2D hand-drawn digital cartoon in a modern noir graphic-novel look, like frames from one animated series. Every shape, including hands, faces, fur, objects and backgrounds, is drawn with bold, clean, uniform black ink outlines and filled with flat cel colour plus one or two hard-edged shadow tones; soft gradient only inside the deepest shadows. Fur and hair are crisp jagged ink strokes. Hands and skin are simple drawn shapes with ink outlines and flat colour, smooth, without pores or wrinkles. Materials such as wax, brass, wood, cloth and water are drawn as flat shapes with one hard white highlight, matte, never glossy. Lighting: one warm amber lamp key light, deep charcoal and sepia shadows, a thin warm rim light on edges, high contrast. Palette: amber, sepia, charcoal, maroon, indigo, brass and ochre, with turquoise only for sea water.
style.suffix_9x16: . Vertical 9:16 frame. Every sign, page and banner is blank or carries unreadable squiggles. Same 2D noir graphic-novel cartoon style as the style reference: bold uniform black outlines, flat cel colour, hard-edged shadows, drawn hands and materials.
style.suffix_16x9: . Cinematic 16:9 frame. Every sign, page and banner is blank or carries unreadable squiggles. Same 2D noir graphic-novel cartoon style as the style reference: bold uniform black outlines, flat cel colour, hard-edged shadows, drawn hands and materials.

profile_picture.prompt:
Channel profile picture, square 1:1, of SUTRADHAR, the same anthropomorphic Indian grey wolf as the reference image, 2D digital cartoon in a modern noir graphic-novel style, thick clean black outlines, smooth cel shading, fur drawn with crisp jagged strokes.
FRAMING: head and upper shoulders only, centred, the face filling about 70% of the frame, with a little empty space around the ears so it survives a circular crop.
EXPRESSION: suspicious detective attitude: eyes narrowed and heavy-lidded, sharp golden-amber eyes looking straight at the viewer over round brass-rimmed spectacles worn low on his snout, one eyebrow raised high, a slow smug one-sided smirk, chin slightly lowered as if he has just caught you lying.
DETAILS: broad wolf skull, heavy muzzle, thick grey-tawny fur ruff at the neck, maroon bandhgala collar with brass buttons, indigo stole on one shoulder, exactly one pair of spectacles.
LIGHTING: single warm amber lamp light from the lower left, a strong rim light on the fur edges, deep shadow on the right side of the face.
BACKGROUND: plain deep charcoal-to-sepia gradient with a soft dark vignette, nothing else.
High contrast, bold and readable at small sizes. No text, no letters, no watermark.

framing.vertical_rule: native 9:16; subject's face in the upper-middle third; keep faces and key action out of the top 12% and bottom 20% (platform buttons); stage in depth, not side by side

narrator_shots._rule: Reusable narrator (SUTRADHAR) shots. Vary them: never the same template twice in a row. Templates with speaks=true show his face and get his exact line as dialogue so Flow animates his mouth (the Flow voice is discarded; assemble-short retimes the clip to the ElevenLabs line). Templates with speaks=false keep his mouth closed (voice-over over that shot). Props (lantern, scroll) are carried in a shot, not part of his fixed design.

walk_in.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} walking toward the camera down a narrow aisle of a lamp-lit stone archive, tall shelves of rolled scrolls on both sides rising to the top of frame, a small brass lantern he carries swinging gently at his hip, {extra}
walk_in.motion: Camera tracks slowly backward at his walking pace. He walks toward the lens, lifts his eyes to the viewer and stops in a medium shot, lantern glow swaying on the shelves.

scroll_reveal.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} holding an old scroll open toward the camera, a small model of {topic_visual} rising out of the parchment between his paws, warm lantern light from below-left, archive shelves softly blurred behind
scroll_reveal.motion: Locked camera with a slow push-in. He unrolls the scroll toward the lens and the tiny model rises out of it, his eyes looking over it into the lens.

cut_in_finger.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} snapping the scroll shut in one paw and raising one clawed finger of the other paw beside his muzzle, one eyebrow raised, dark archive background with a single warm rim light
cut_in_finger.motion: Quick short push-in, then hold. He snaps the scroll shut and raises one finger beside his muzzle, one brow raised.

lean_in_question.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} leaning toward the camera, {pose}, {context_visual} softly blurred behind him, warm rim light
lean_in_question.motion: Locked camera. He leans in toward the lens, one ear twitching, the raised brow lifting.

point_at_viewer.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} pointing one paw straight at the camera with his smug one-sided smirk, lantern glow on his fur, {context_visual} in soft background
point_at_viewer.motion: Locked camera, very slight push-in. His paw comes up and points straight at the lens.

touch_diorama.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} crouching beside a tabletop miniature model of {topic_visual}, reaching out with one paw to {touch_action}, lantern set down beside him
touch_diorama.motion: Slow descending crane toward him. He reaches out and {touch_action}, then lifts his face to the camera.

eye_ecu.prompt: extreme close-up of one golden-amber eye of {SUTRADHAR} peering over the brass rim of his round spectacles, flickering lantern light reflected in the iris, grey-tawny inked fur strokes filling the frame
eye_ecu.motion: Slow push-in toward the eye. The pupil narrows slightly as the lantern flickers. End on the reflection in the iris. His mouth stays closed in his smirk the whole time; his face and body carry the beat (brow, eyes, head tilt, paws).

map_tap_ots.prompt: over-the-shoulder view from behind {SUTRADHAR} as he stands before a large carved relief map of India on the archive wall, {map_note}, the lantern raised in one paw
map_tap_ots.motion: Locked camera behind his shoulder. He reaches up and taps the glowing marker; it pulses brighter. End with his paw on the marker and his head turning halfway back toward camera. His mouth stays closed in his smirk the whole time; his face and body carry the beat (brow, eyes, head tilt, paws).

walk_off.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} seen from behind walking away from camera {where}, the lantern the only warm light, long shadow stretching toward the lens
walk_off.motion: Locked camera. He walks away into the dark, stops, and looks back over his shoulder at the viewer for a beat. End on the over-the-shoulder glance with the lantern glowing. His mouth stays closed in his smirk the whole time; his face and body carry the beat (brow, eyes, head tilt, paws).

map_present.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} standing beside a large carved relief map of India on the archive wall, body turned toward the camera, one paw resting on the map at {map_note}, the lantern hanging from his other paw
map_present.motion: Locked camera. Facing the lens, he taps the marker on the map; it pulses brighter while he keeps his eyes on the viewer.

sign_off.prompt: {SUTRADHAR} close to the camera at the end of a dark archive aisle, lantern held low so its warm light catches his spectacles and the underside of his muzzle, {where} receding into shadow behind him
sign_off.motion: Locked camera. He looks into the lens; when he finishes he gives a slow knowing nod, turns and steps away into the shadows, his lantern glowing.

close_whisper.prompt: {SUTRADHAR}'s face close to the camera, lit only by the lantern held just below frame, golden-amber eyes over the brass rims of his spectacles, deep shadow on one side of his face
close_whisper.motion: Very slow push-in. He leans a little closer, eyes narrowing as if sharing a secret.

flow.tool: Google Flow (Veo for clips, Imagen for stills)
flow.settings: Aspect ratio: 9:16 portrait. Clip length: 8 s (Flow default); use the first seconds listed per shot, they are the cleanest. Generate 2-4 takes per clip and pick one.

modes.ingredients: Ingredients to Video: attach the listed images (style key first, max 3 in total) and paste the prompt.
modes.image: Image: attach the listed images as references (style key first) and paste the prompt; the edit adds a slow push or pan.
modes.frames: Frames to Video: attach the approved still as the first frame and paste the prompt.
modes.text: Text to Video (not used: every shot carries the style key).

flow.audio_rule: Non-speaking shots: ambient sound only, ending 'No music, no speech.' Speaking shots (SUTRADHAR on screen with a line): the exact Hindi line as dialogue, voice only. The edit mutes Flow's voice and lip-syncs the clip to the ElevenLabs line.

consistency_rule: Every prompt that shows a character carries, verbatim: its reference sheet (attached), its role line, its scene_tag, and its lock. Never paraphrase a lock; change it only here (version + changelog).

speech.voice_desc: in Hindi, in a deep, calm, slightly smug storyteller voice
speech.mouth: His mouth moves clearly and naturally with every syllable, jaw and lips shaping each word; when the line ends his mouth closes into his smirk.
speech.audio: Audio: only the wolf narrator's voice speaking the line, over near-silent room tone. No music, no sound effects.
speech.note: Flow's voice is only a lip-sync guide: the assembly mutes it, finds its speech span, and retimes the clip (0.7x-1.4x) so the mouth lands on the ElevenLabs line.
